functions.name: upload-document
functions.description: Upload an original file as a Factorial document, choose its visibility and destination, and optionally request electronic signatures.

space.description: Destination document space; employee_my_documents requires employeeId.

public.description: Whether the document is public within Factorial's visibility model.

filename.description: Final document filename, including extension, as ordinary Unicode text.

companyId.description: Company that will own the document.

contentType.description: MIME content type of the original bytes, such as application/pdf.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of exact original file bytes, at most 5 MiB decoded; not text to be interpreted or re-encoded.

authorAccessId.description: Author's user access identifier, not an assumed employee ID.

signeeAccessIds.description: User access identifiers of signees, in caller order; defaults to no signees.

items.description: User access identifier of a signee.

requestEsignature.description: Request electronic signatures during upload; defaults to false.

isPendingAssignment.description: Whether this document is pending assignment.

FunctionInput_factorial_api_key_uploaddo.description: Original file bytes and the destination, visibility, author and optional signature settings for a new Factorial document.

createdAt.description: Document creation instant in UTC Z with source precision retained.

updatedAt.description: Document update instant in UTC Z with source precision retained.

fileSizeBytes.description: Stored file size in bytes, if returned.

signatureStatus.description: Provider signature workflow status, if returned; not proof of recipient delivery.

FunctionOutput_factorial_api_key_uploadd.description: Created document metadata and any reported signature workflow state, without implying delivery or signature completion.

tags.instructions: Use this for a new file, not to change document metadata. Obtain company, author access and any employee IDs from your account records; folder IDs come from `list-folders`. Author and signee IDs are access IDs, not automatically employee IDs. Maximum original content is 5 MiB. Signature requests may notify signees; success does not mean they signed or received delivery. Use `get-document` to inspect the resulting metadata.
